title: Roles and Permissions: Control Who Can Do What | Orchard Core
description:
Not everyone who uses a site should be able to do everything. Orchard Core decides who can view, edit, publish, and manage what with roles and permissions.

A permission is one thing a person may do, a role is a named set of permissions, and a user receives the permissions of every role they have. This video walks through the Roles page, creates a role, chooses its permissions, and gives the role to a user.

In this video:
• Roles, permissions, and the Administrator, Anonymous, and Authenticated system roles
• The Roles page under Access Control
• Create a role with a name and a description
• Choose permissions: Allow, Effective, and Security Critical
• Give a role to a user
• Delete a role
• The four points to remember
